page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block from top to bottom; below it a woodcut of a tree with a serpent and a banner; below that the imprint centred in three lines and a date line. Handwritten page number at top right is not printed and is left out.

main_text.l: D. JOHANNIS COCCEJI, S.S. Theol. Doct.
ejusdemque Facultatis in Illustri Acad. Lugd. Bat.
A. D. Iunii, loco horisque solitis, ante mer.

page.notes: Woodcut of a tree with a serpent wrapped around it, a banner reading "NON SOLUS", and a standing figure beside the tree; engraving described, not transcribed. Faint show-through of mirrored text from the reverse appears across the page and is omitted. The date line is in the old reversed-C form and is rendered as a Roman numeral (MDCLXVIII). The banner text "NON SOLUS" is read from a small, partly obscured woodcut and may be imperfect.
